memes.image_prompt:
Realistic magazine photo, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field. A real wooden front porch at dusk on Halloween, a few real carved pumpkins on the steps lit by candles inside, dry autumn leaves, warm porch light. Fluxion's official mascot — a small glossy black vinyl-toy cat with three spiky ears, white swirl logo on the forehead, blue-to-purple glowing visor with cyan LED eyes, glowing nebula belly and a flame-tipped tail — is "hiding" inside the biggest pumpkin: its three spiky ears poke out of the top, the visor glow shines through the carved eyes, and the flame-tipped tail sticks out the back. Warm ambient light, soft shadows, contact shadow on the wood; the only glow besides candles is on the toy. No text on the image. 4:5 vertical.
Avoid: neon environments, glowing water, purple/cyan fantasy CGI backgrounds, oversaturated sci-fi, heavy on-image text.
